text: Written off. On my record. Unthinkable.
raw:
SCORE: 6/10
REASON:
- s09 · R3 (blocking, −4) "Written off. On my record. Unthinkable." This line fires on `impact`, and a hit line must never say "written off" because only the `writeoff` event logs a destroyed body. [EDIT26#6.6] Fix: "A collision. On my record. Unthinkable."
Total: 10 − 4 = 6.
